magic.name: The Shared Sheaf
magic.account: A bright sheaf floats over the well. Millers call it the first harvest carried from their lost world.
magic.custom: Households keep an arrival cup ready for a traveler who has yet to reach the square.

magic.name: The Patient Hammer
magic.account: A stone-colored hammer hangs above the well. Masons say its shape survived the collapse before any of their houses did.
magic.custom: Masons name a repaired stone for the neighbor who helped put it back.

magic.name: The Neighbors Lantern
magic.account: The court keeps a lantern-shaped light above the well. Its makers tell travelers that every former world had a different way to welcome the dark.
magic.custom: Neighbors lend a lamp to a guest who arrives after dark.

magic.name: The Open Pages
magic.account: Two bright pages float over the well. Copyists disagree about their missing words, but Milewardens record every account beside its speaker's name.
magic.custom: Copyists preserve disagreeing accounts beside their speakers' names rather than choosing one for everyone.

magic.name: The Root Remembered
magic.account: A branching light hangs above the well. Families keep copies of agreements their ancestors made with forests that no longer stand in the same sky.
magic.custom: Households ask their neighbors before pruning shared roots.

magic.name: The Well Leaf
magic.account: A leaf-shaped light floats over the well. Gardeners keep old names for plants brought together from worlds that once had separate seasons.
magic.custom: Each household gives a neighbor a labeled cutting when it begins a new garden.

magic.name: The Unbroken Prism
magic.account: A faceted light hovers over the well. Glassworkers call it a piece of the sea their grandparents lost when the worlds became one.
magic.custom: Residents shade their water vessels and offer guests a drink before asking for news.

magic.name: The Agreed Hour
magic.account: A bright dial rests above the well. Makers inherited clocks from several lost worlds, each certain that its own hour was correct.
magic.custom: When clocks disagree, a human caller announces the time for a meeting.

magic.name: The Open Arch
magic.account: A small shining arch stands in the air above the well. The court welcomes pilgrims whose old holy places now lie beneath unfamiliar stars.
magic.custom: Guests may share a remembered faith or custom without being asked to adopt the neighbors' beliefs.

magic.name: The Lasting Fruit
magic.account: A fruit-shaped light hangs over the well. Grafting families trace their oldest trees to orchards that once grew in different worlds.
magic.custom: Growers leave part of each harvest for travelers who arrive late.

magic.name: The Borrowed Sky
magic.account: A ribbon of light hangs above the well. Watchers name its colors after skies their ancestors saw before the multiverse collapsed.
magic.custom: The watch wraps its road bells in cloth when a traveler is overdue.

city_bellkeepers_hearth.name: Bellkeepers Hearth
city_bellkeepers_hearth.trade: bell repairs, fuel and warm provisions

magic.name: The Silent Bell
magic.account: A bell-shaped light floats above the well without a sound. Families say it remembers the last call heard in their former world.
magic.custom: Neighbors unwrap the road bells when a missing traveler returns.

city_rainwood.name: Rainwood Street
city_rainwood.trade: timber, cloth repairs and road letters

magic.name: The Rainwood Screen
magic.account: A slatted light floats over the well. Woodworkers remember streets lined with household workshops in the world their ancestors left.
magic.custom: Neighbors offer visitors a dry cloth and a place to wait for the rain.

city_reedpaper.name: Reedpaper Court
city_reedpaper.trade: paper, copied letters and garden provisions

magic.name: The Folded Letter
magic.account: A folded light hangs above the well. Families carried the habit of keeping handwritten letters when their old streets vanished.
magic.custom: A host asks whether a traveler wants company or a quiet corner before bringing tea.

magic.name: The Joined Beam
magic.account: A stepped beam of light floats above the well. Joiners say it recalls houses rebuilt from the timbers of several former worlds.
magic.custom: Neighbors keep a shared list of useful offcuts before buying new timber.

city_porcelain_exchange.name: Porcelain Exchange
city_porcelain_exchange.trade: ceramic vessels, tea supplies and caravan repairs

magic.name: The Offered Bowl
magic.account: A bright bowl rests in the air above the well. Potters and caravan households keep different accounts of which former world first taught them its shape.
magic.custom: A host asks guests how they prefer their tea before pouring it.

city_warmstone.name: Warmstone Village
city_warmstone.trade: hearth provisions, roof repairs and household tools

magic.name: The Kept Warmth
magic.account: A warm-colored stone hangs above the well. Families remember homes where stone floors and airy wooden rooms served different seasons.
magic.custom: Hosts make space for guests shoes before inviting them into the household room.

city_moonjar.name: Moonjar Commons
city_moonjar.trade: white vessels, repairs and shared kitchen supplies

magic.name: The Round Vessel
magic.account: A milk-white vessel of light floats above the well. Potters prize the slight differences left by each pair of working hands.
magic.custom: Neighbors return a borrowed vessel with a little food inside.

city_harvestmask.name: Harvestmask Hollow
city_harvestmask.trade: harvest bread, masks and household lanterns

magic.name: The Grinning Harvest
magic.account: A grinning harvest light floats above the well. Maskmakers treat the frightening faces as invitations to an evening meal.
magic.custom: Guests may borrow a mask, and anyone may decline without being teased.

city_candlewake.name: Candlewake Borough
city_candlewake.trade: candles, remembrance books and autumn provisions

magic.name: The Name Kept Lit
magic.account: A candle-shaped light hangs above the well. Residents remember absent neighbors through stories that include their jokes and everyday kindness.
magic.custom: A guest may offer a name for the evening remembrance, or sit quietly with the others.

city_evergreen_hearth.name: Evergreen Hearth
city_evergreen_hearth.trade: warm bread, winter fuel and shared provisions

magic.name: The Evergreen Welcome
magic.account: An evergreen-shaped light floats above the well. Winter households carried their feast customs into the Endless World and kept room for new neighbors.
magic.custom: Residents set aside a warm meal for someone traveling after the feast has begun.

city_giftmakers.name: Giftmakers Square
city_giftmakers.trade: small gifts, toy repairs and winter clothing

magic.name: The Unfinished Gift
magic.account: A ribbon-wrapped light hangs over the well. Makers say the best gifts still leave their recipients room to choose what they become.
magic.custom: The town repairs old gifts alongside making new ones, and keeps giving voluntary.

city_neon_relay.name: Neon Relay
city_neon_relay.trade: message relays, etched plates and circuit repairs

magic.name: The Shared Signal
magic.account: A bright relay form floats over the well. Technomancers rebuilt familiar signal patterns with the magic available after their worlds collapsed.
magic.custom: Neighbors post a plain-language copy beside every encoded public notice.

city_chrome_bazaar.name: Chrome Bazaar
city_chrome_bazaar.trade: conductive fittings, repairs and caravan components

magic.name: The Common Circuit
magic.account: A square circuit of light hangs above the well. Repairers reuse metal from a former world whose machines no longer understand the new sky.
magic.custom: Repairers explain a patch to its owner before closing the casing.

magic.name: The Public Working
magic.account: A small star of light floats over the well. Bookbinders copy the instructions for maintaining it beside the records of who last repaired it.
magic.custom: A charm maker explains what a household working does before asking anyone to trust it.

city_observatory.name: Observatory Court
city_observatory.trade: star charts, lenses and copied observations

magic.name: The Unfinished Chart
magic.account: A bright frame circles a small light above the well. Observers map a sky assembled from histories that once belonged to separate worlds.
magic.custom: People date each observation and preserve the earlier chart when a new one disagrees.

city_dewbell.name: Dewbell Commons
city_dewbell.trade: flower remedies, garden provisions and tiny bells

magic.name: The Morning Drop
magic.account: A dew-shaped light hangs above the well. Garden households remember a former world where a flower could shelter an entire family.
magic.custom: Visitors ask before picking flowers, including blooms growing beside a public path.

city_petalweave.name: Petalweave Court
city_petalweave.trade: woven charms, household repairs and flower dyes

magic.name: The Borrowed Bloom
magic.account: A flower-shaped light floats above the well. Weavers kept a pattern from their lost world and let each new household add a color.
magic.custom: A borrower returns thread with a small repair they can offer in exchange.
